title: त्रिपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 53 · Chyavana tests the king and queen

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks what the king and his wife did when the sage vanished. Bhishma tells how the sage burned the food and then made the king and queen draw his chariot, whipped them, and they bore it without any change of heart, and he went to a lovely forest.
summary.kn: ಋಷಿ ಅದೃಶ್ಯನಾದಾಗ ರಾಜ-ರಾಣಿ ಏನು ಮಾಡಿದರೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಋಷಿ ಅನ್ನ ಸುಟ್ಟು ರಾಜ-ರಾಣಿಯರನ್ನು ರಥ ಎಳೆಯಲು ಹೇಳಿ ಚಾವಟಿಯಿಂದ ಹೊಡೆದರೂ ಅವರು ವಿಕಾರವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಸಹಿಸಿದರು, ಋಷಿ ಸುಂದರ ವನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि ऋषि के अन्तर्धान होने पर राजा और रानी ने क्या किया। भीष्म बताते हैं कि ऋषि ने भोजन जला दिया, फिर राजा-रानी से रथ खिंचवाया और कोड़े मारे पर उन्होंने बिना विकार के सहा, और ऋषि सुन्दर वन में गए।
summary.te: ఋషి అదృశ్యమైనప్పుడు రాజు, రాణి ఏం చేశారని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. ఋషి అన్నాన్ని కాల్చి, రాజు రాణులచే రథం లాగించి కొరడాతో కొట్టినా వారు మార్పు లేకుండా సహించారని, ఋషి అందమైన వనానికి వెళ్లాడని భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: முனிவர் மறைந்தபோது மன்னனும் அரசியும் என்ன செய்தனர் என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, முனிவர் உணவை எரித்து, பின் மன்னனையும் அரசியையும் தேர் இழுக்கச் செய்து சாட்டையால் அடித்தபோதும் அவர்கள் மாற்றமின்றிச் சகித்தனர், முனிவர் அழகிய காட்டுக்குச் சென்றார் என்று பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: മുനി മറഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ രാജാവും ഭാര്യയും എന്തു ചെയ്തുവെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. ഭക്ഷണം കത്തിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞശേഷം മുനി രാജാവിനെയും രാജ്ഞിയെയും തന്റെ രഥം വലിപ്പിക്കുകയും ചാട്ടവാറടിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നതെങ്ങനെയെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ വിവരിക്കുന്നു; അവർ മാറ്റമില്ലാതെ അത് സഹിക്കുന്നു, മുനി മനോഹരമായ ഒരു വനത്തിലേക്ക് പോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.53; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
तस्मिन्नन्तर्हिते विप्रे राजा किमकरोत्तदा ।
भार्या चास्य महाभागा तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥

meaning.en: When the brahmin vanished, what did the king do then, and what did his illustrious wife do? Tell me that, grandfather.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अदृष्ट्वा स महीपालस्तमृषिं सह भार्यया ।
परिश्रान्तो निववृते व्रीडितो नष्टचेतनः ॥

meaning.en: Not finding the sage, the king and his wife, exhausted, ashamed and bewildered, turned back.

verses.text:
स प्रविश्य पुरीं दीनो नाभ्यभाषत किंचन ।
तदेव चिन्तयामास च्यवनस्य विचेष्टितम् ॥

meaning.en: Entering the city dejected, he said nothing to anyone, but kept brooding over Chyavana's strange doings.

verses.text:
अथ शून्येन मनसा प्रविवेश गृहं नृपः ।
ददर्श शयने तस्मिञ्शयानं भृगुनन्दनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, with a vacant mind, the king entered his house, and saw the son of Bhrigu lying asleep on that very bed.

verses.text:
विस्मितौ तौ तु दृष्ट्वा तं तदाश्चर्यं विचिन्त्य च ।
दर्शनात्तस्य च मुनेर्विश्रान्तौ संबभूवतुः ॥

meaning.en: The two were amazed at the sight, thought over the marvel, and were refreshed simply by seeing the sage.

verses.text:
यथास्थानं तु तौ स्थित्वा भूयस्तं संववाहतुः ।
अथापरेण पार्श्वेन सुष्वाप स महामुनिः ॥

meaning.en: Standing in their proper places, they again began to massage him; then the great sage turned over and slept on his other side.

verses.text:
तेनैव च स कालेन प्रत्यबुध्यत वीर्यवान् ।
न च तौ चक्रतुः किंचिद्विकारं भयशङ्कितौ ॥

meaning.en: He slept just so long, and the mighty one awoke; and the two, though fearful, showed no sign of vexation.

verses.text:
प्रतिबुद्धस्तु स मुनिस्तौ प्रोवाच विशां पते ।
तैलाभ्यङ्गो दीयतां मे स्नास्येऽहमिति भारत ॥

meaning.en: Awake, the sage said to them, "Lord of the people, Bharata, give me an oil rub; I wish to bathe."

verses.text:
तथेति तौ प्रतिश्रुत्य क्षुधितौ श्रमकर्शितौ ।
शतपाकेन तैलेन महार्हेणोपतस्थतुः ॥

meaning.en: Saying "So be it," the two, hungry and worn out with toil, attended him with costly oil that had been cooked a hundred times.

verses.text:
ततः सुखासीनमृषिं वाग्यतौ संववाहतुः ।
न च पर्याप्तमित्याह भार्गवः सुमहातपाः ॥

meaning.en: Then, as the sage sat at ease, they massaged him in silence; yet the greatly ascetic Bhargava did not say it was enough.

verses.text:
यदा तौ निर्विकारौ तु लक्षयामास भार्गवः ।
तत उत्थाय सहसा स्नानशालां विवेश ह ।
कॢप्तमेव तु तत्रासीत्स्नानीयं पार्थिवोचितम् ॥

meaning.en: When Bhargava saw that the two showed no displeasure, he suddenly rose and entered the bathing hall, where bathing things fit for a king had been laid out.

verses.text:
असत्कृत्य तु तत्सर्वं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ।
स मुनिः पुनरेवाथ नृपतेः पश्यतस्तदा ।
नासूयां चक्रतुस्तौ च दंपती भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Disdaining all of that, he vanished right there. And though the sage again did this before the king's eyes, O best of Bharatas, the couple felt no resentment.

verses.text:
अथ स्नातः स भगवान्सिंहासनगतः प्रभुः ।
दर्शयामास कुशिकं सभार्यं भृगुनन्दनः ॥

meaning.en: Then the lord, having bathed, came seated on a throne, and the son of Bhrigu showed himself to Kushika and his wife.

verses.text:
संहृष्टवदनो राजा सभार्यः कुशिको मुनिम् ।
सिद्धमन्नमिति प्रह्वो निर्विकारो न्यवेदयत् ॥

meaning.en: With a cheerful face, humbly and without any change of mood, King Kushika and his wife reported to the sage that food was ready.

verses.text:
आनीयतामिति मुनिस्तं चोवाच नराधिपम् ।
राजा च समुपाजह्रे तदन्नं सह भार्यया ॥

meaning.en: "Let it be brought," the sage told the king, and the king with his wife brought that food.

verses.text:
मांसप्रकारान्विविधाञ्शाकानि विविधानि च ।
वेसवारविकारांश्च पानकानि लघूनि च ॥

meaning.en: It had many kinds of meat dishes and many vegetables, spiced preparations, light drinks,

verses.text:
रसालापूपकांश्चित्रान्मोदकानथ षाडवान् ।
रसान्नानाप्रकारांश्च वन्यं च मुनिभोजनम् ॥

meaning.en: juicy cakes of many sorts, sweetmeats, sweets of the six tastes, many kinds of broths, and the forest food of sages,

verses.text:
फलानि च विचित्राणि तथा भोज्यानि भूरिशः ।
बदरेङ्गुदकाश्मर्यभल्लातकवटानि च ॥

meaning.en: varied fruits and plentiful dishes: jujube, ingudi, ashmari, bhallataka and banyan fruit,

verses.text:
गृहस्थानां च यद्भोज्यं यच्चापि वनवासिनाम् ।
सर्वमाहारयामास राजा शापभयान्मुनेः ॥

meaning.en: whatever householders eat and whatever forest-dwellers eat, the king had all of it fetched, out of fear of the sage's curse.

verses.text:
अथ सर्वमुपन्यस्तमग्रतश्च्यवनस्य तत् ।
ततः सर्वं समानीय तच्च शय्यासनं मुनिः ॥

meaning.en: When everything had been set before Chyavana, the sage gathered it all together, along with the bed and seat,

verses.text:
वस्त्रैः शुभैरवच्छाद्य भोजनोपस्करैः सह ।
सर्वमादीपयामास च्यवनो भृगुनन्दनः ॥

meaning.en: covered it with fine cloths, along with the dining utensils, and Chyavana, son of Bhrigu, set it all ablaze.

verses.text:
न च तौ चक्रतुः कोपं दंपती सुमहाव्रतौ ।
तयोः संप्रेक्षतोरेव पुनरन्तर्हितोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: The couple, firm in great vows, still showed no anger; and while they looked on, he vanished again.

verses.text:
तत्रैव च स राजर्षिस्तस्थौ तां रजनीं तदा ।
सभार्यो वाग्यतः श्रीमान्न च तं कोप आविशत् ॥

meaning.en: The royal sage, together with his wife, stayed there that night, silent and splendid, and no anger entered him.

verses.text:
नित्यं संस्कृतमन्नं तु विविधं राजवेश्मनि ।
शयनानि च मुख्यानि परिषेकाश्च पुष्कलाः ॥

meaning.en: In the king's house, finely prepared food of every kind was supplied daily, along with excellent beds and abundant bathing supplies,

verses.text:
वस्त्रं च विविधाकारमभवत्समुपार्जितम् ।
न शशाक ततो द्रष्टुमन्तरं च्यवनस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: and clothes of many shapes were obtained too; yet Chyavana could find no flaw in them.

verses.text:
पुनरेव च विप्रर्षिः प्रोवाच कुशिकं नृपम् ।
सभार्यो मां रथेनाशु वह यत्र ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: Again the brahmin sage said to King Kushika, "Quickly carry me, with your wife, in a chariot to where I tell you."

verses.text:
तथेति च प्राह नृपो निर्विशङ्कस्तपोधनम् ।
क्रीडारथोऽस्तु भगवन्नुत सांग्रामिको रथः ॥

meaning.en: Without hesitation the king said to the ascetic, "Lord, shall it be a pleasure chariot or a war chariot?"

verses.text:
इत्युक्तः स मुनिस्तेन राज्ञा हृष्टेन तद्वचः ।
च्यवनः प्रत्युवाचेदं हृष्टः परपुरंजयम् ॥

meaning.en: So addressed by the delighted king, Chyavana, also pleased, replied to that conqueror of enemy cities.

verses.text:
सज्जीकुरु रथं क्षिप्रं यस्ते सांग्रामिको मतः ।
सायुधः सपताकश्च सशक्तिः कणयष्टिमान् ॥

meaning.en: "Quickly make ready the chariot you reckon a war chariot, with weapons, banners, spears and goads of gold,

verses.text:
किङ्किणीशतनिर्घोषो युक्तस्तोमरकल्पनैः ।
गदाखड्गनिबद्धश्च परमेषुशतान्वितः ॥

meaning.en: resounding with a hundred tinkling bells, fitted with lances, hung with maces and swords, and with hundreds of excellent arrows."

verses.text:
ततः स तं तथेत्युक्त्वा कल्पयित्वा महारथम् ।
भार्यां वामे धुरि तदा चात्मानं दक्षिणे तथा ॥

meaning.en: Saying "So be it," the king prepared that great chariot, set his wife on the left yoke-pole and himself on the right,

verses.text:
त्रिदंष्ट्रं वज्रसूच्यग्रं प्रतोदं तत्र चादधत् ।
सर्वमेतत्ततो दत्त्वा नृपो वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: and placed there a goad with three prongs and a point sharp as a diamond needle. Having given all this, the king spoke.

verses.text:
भगवन्क्व रथो यातु ब्रवीतु भृगुनन्दनः ।
यत्र वक्ष्यसि विप्रर्षे तत्र यास्यति ते रथः ॥

meaning.en: "Lord, where should the chariot go? Let the son of Bhrigu say. Wherever you direct, brahmin sage, your chariot will go."

verses.text:
एवमुक्तस्तु भगवान्प्रत्युवाचाथ तं नृपम् ।
इतःप्रभृति यातव्यं पदकं पदकं शनैः ॥

meaning.en: So addressed, the lord replied to the king, "From here on you must go very slowly, step by step.

verses.text:
श्रमो मम यथा न स्यात्तथा मे छन्दचारिणौ ।
सुखं चैवास्मि वोढव्यो जनः सर्वश्च पश्यतु ॥

meaning.en: Go at your own pace, so that I am not tired; I must be carried comfortably, and let all the people see.

verses.text:
नोत्सार्यः पथिकः कश्चित्तेभ्यो दास्याम्यहं वसु ।
ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च ये कामानर्थयिष्यन्ति मां पथि ॥

meaning.en: No traveller is to be driven off. I will give wealth to them, and to the brahmins who ask me for their wishes along the road.

verses.text:
सर्वं दास्याम्यशेषेण धनं रत्नानि चैव हि ।
क्रियतां निखिलेनैतन्मा विचारय पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: I shall give away everything, all my wealth and jewels, without remainder. Let all of this be done, king, and do not hesitate."

verses.text:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा भृत्यानथाब्रवीत् ।
यद्यद्ब्रूयान्मुनिस्तत्तत्सर्वं देयमशङ्कितैः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his words, the king told his servants, "Whatever the sage asks for, give all of it without hesitation."

verses.text:
ततो रत्नान्यनेकानि स्त्रियो युग्यमजाविकम् ।
कृताकृतं च कनकं गजेन्द्राश्चाचलोपमाः ॥

meaning.en: Then many jewels, women, teams of draught animals, goats and sheep, worked and unworked gold, and elephants like mountains

verses.text:
अन्वगच्छन्त तमृषिं राजामात्याश्च सर्वशः ।
हाहाभूतं च तत्सर्वमासीन्नगरमार्तिमत् ॥

meaning.en: followed the sage, and the king's ministers all around; and that whole city became full of cries of woe and distress.

verses.text:
तौ तीक्ष्णाग्रेण सहसा प्रतोदेन प्रचोदितौ ।
पृष्ठे विद्धौ कटे चैव निर्विकारौ तमूहतुः ॥

meaning.en: Suddenly urged on by the sharp-pointed goad, struck on the back and hips, the two pulled him unchanged in demeanour.

verses.text:
वेपमानौ विराहारौ पञ्चाशद्रात्रकर्शितौ ।
कथंचिदूहतुर्वीरौ दंपती तं रथोत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Trembling, fasting, wasted by fifty nights without food, the heroic couple somehow pulled that best of chariots.

verses.text:
बहुशो भृशविद्धौ तौ क्षरमाणौ क्षतोद्भवम् ।
ददृशाते महाराज पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ ॥

meaning.en: Struck many times, deeply, and bleeding from their wounds, O great king, they looked like two flowering kimshuka trees.

verses.text:
तौ दृष्ट्वा पौरवर्गस्तु भृशं शोकपरायणः ।
अभिशापभयात्त्रस्तो न च किंचिदुवाच ह ॥

meaning.en: Seeing them, the townspeople were overcome with grief, and, terrified of being cursed, said nothing at all.

verses.text:
द्वन्द्वशश्चाब्रुवन्सर्वे पश्यध्वं तपसो बलम् ।
क्रुद्धा अपि मुनिश्रेष्ठं वीक्षितुं नैव शक्नुमः ॥

meaning.en: In pairs they all murmured, "Behold the power of asceticism! Though angry, we cannot even look at the best of sages.

verses.text:
अहो भगवतो वीर्यं महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः ।
राज्ञश्चापि सभार्यस्य धैर्यं पश्यत यादृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Ah, the might of the lord, the great sage of cultivated soul! And behold the steadiness of the king and his wife.

verses.text:
श्रान्तावपि हि कृच्छ्रेण रथमेतं समूहतुः ।
न चैतयोर्विकारं वै ददर्श भृगुनन्दनः ॥

meaning.en: Though weary, they pull this chariot with difficulty, and the son of Bhrigu has seen no change in them."

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
ततः स निर्विकारौ तौ दृष्ट्वा भृगुकुलोद्वहः ।
वसु विश्राणयामास यथा वैश्रवणस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Then the pride of the Bhrigu line, seeing them unchanged, scattered wealth like Vaishravana, god of riches.

verses.text:
तत्रापि राजा प्रीतात्मा यथाज्ञप्तमथाकरोत् ।
ततोऽस्य भगवान्प्रीतो बभूव मुनिसत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: Even then the king, glad at heart, did as he was bid, and thereby the revered, best of sages became pleased with him.

verses.text:
अवतीर्य रथश्रेष्ठाद्दंपती तौ मुमोच ह ।
विमोच्य चैतौ विधिवत्ततो वाक्यमुवाच ह ॥

meaning.en: Stepping down from the best of chariots, he released the couple; and having properly freed them, he spoke.

verses.text:
स्निग्धगम्भीरया वाचा भार्गवः सुप्रसन्नया ।
ददानि वां वरं श्रेष्ठं तद्ब्रूतामिति भारत ॥

meaning.en: In a kind, deep, and very gracious voice the Bhargava said, "I will grant you both an excellent boon; say it, Bharata."

verses.text:
सुकुमारौ च तौ विद्वान्कराभ्यां मुनिसत्तमः ।
पस्पर्शामृतकल्पाभ्यां स्नेहाद्भरतसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: The wise best of sages, out of affection, touched the two delicate ones with his hands, which were like nectar, O best of Bharatas.

verses.text:
अथाब्रवीन्नृपो वाक्यं श्रमो नास्त्यावयोरिह ।
विश्रान्तौ स्वः प्रभावात्ते ध्यानेनैवेति भार्गव ॥

meaning.en: Then the king said, "O Bhargava, we feel no fatigue here; by your power, and by your meditation, we are rested."

verses.text:
अथ तौ भगवान्प्राह प्रहृष्टश्च्यवनस्तदा ।
न वृथा व्याहृतं पूर्वं यन्मया तद्भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Then the lord Chyavana, delighted, said to them, "What I said before was not spoken in vain; it will come to pass.

verses.text:
रमणीयः समुद्देशो गङ्गातीरमिदं शुभम् ।
कंचित्कालं व्रतपरो निवत्स्यामीह पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: This lovely spot on the bank of the Ganga is pleasant; I will stay here for a while, intent on a vow.

verses.text:
गम्यतां स्वपुरं पुत्र विश्रान्तः पुनरेष्यसि ।
इहस्थं मां सभार्यस्त्वं द्रष्टासि श्वो नराधिप ॥

meaning.en: Go to your own city, son; rest, and come again. Tomorrow, king, you will see me here with your wife.

verses.text:
न च मन्युस्त्वया कार्यः श्रेयस्ते समुपस्थितम् ।
यत्काङ्क्षितं हृदिस्थं ते तत्सर्वं संभविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Do not be angry; good fortune is at hand for you. Whatever you desire in your heart will all come to pass."

verses.text:
इत्येवमुक्तः कुशिकः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना ।
प्रोवाच मुनिशार्दूलमिदं वचनमर्थवत् ॥

meaning.en: So addressed, Kushika, with a delighted heart, spoke these meaningful words to the tiger among sages.

verses.text:
न मे मन्युर्महाभाग पूतोऽस्मि भगवंस्त्वया ।
संवृत्तौ यौवनस्थौ स्वो वपुष्मन्तौ बलान्वितौ ॥

meaning.en: "I have no anger, illustrious one; you have purified me. We have become young, handsome and strong.

verses.text:
प्रतोदेन व्रणा ये मे सभार्यस्य कृतास्त्वया ।
तान्न पश्यामि गात्रेषु स्वस्थोऽस्मि सह भार्यया ॥

meaning.en: I do not see on my body the wounds you made with the goad for me and my wife; I am well, with my wife.

verses.text:
इमां च देवीं पश्यामि मुने दिव्याप्सरोपमाम् ।
श्रिया परमया युक्तां यथादृष्टां मया पुरा ॥

meaning.en: And I see this queen, sage, radiant with supreme beauty, like a divine apsara, just as I saw her before.

verses.text:
तव प्रसादात्संवृत्तमिदं सर्वं महामुने ।
नैतच्चित्रं तु भगवंस्त्वयि सत्यपराक्रम ॥

meaning.en: All this has come about by your grace, great sage; but it is no wonder in you, lord of true prowess."

verses.text:
इत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाचेदं च्यवनः कुशिकं तदा ।
आगच्छेथाः सभार्यश्च त्वमिहेति नराधिप ॥

meaning.en: So addressed, Chyavana then replied to Kushika, "Come here again, king, with your wife."

verses.text:
इत्युक्तः समनुज्ञातो राजर्षिरभिवाद्य तम् ।
प्रययौ वपुषा युक्तो नगरं देवराजवत् ॥

meaning.en: Thus told and dismissed, the royal sage saluted him and went to his city, with a body like Indra's, king of the gods.

verses.text:
तत एनमुपाजग्मुरमात्याः सपुरोहिताः ।
बलस्था गणिकायुक्ताः सर्वाः प्रकृतयस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Then his ministers with the priest, the army, courtesans and all the subjects came to meet him.

verses.text:
तैर्वृतः कुशिको राजा श्रिया परमया ज्वलन् ।
प्रविवेश पुरं हृष्टः पूज्यमानोऽथ बन्दिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded by them, King Kushika, blazing with supreme splendour, entered the city delighted, honoured by bards.

verses.text:
ततः प्रविश्य नगरं कृत्वा सर्वाह्णिकक्रियाः ।
भुक्त्वा सभार्यो रजनीमुवास स महीपतिः ॥

meaning.en: Having entered the city, he performed all the day's rites, ate, and the king spent the night with his wife.

verses.text:
ततस्तु तौ नवमभिवीक्ष्य यौवनं
परस्परं विगतजराविवामरौ ।
ननन्दतुः शयनगतौ वपुर्धरौ
श्रिया युतौ द्विजवरदत्तया तया ॥

meaning.en: Then the two, seeing each other in new youth, as if free of old age like immortals, rejoiced as they lay together, embodied beauty, endowed with the splendour that the best of brahmins had given.

verses.text:
स चाप्यृषिर्भृगुकुलकीर्तिवर्धन-
स्तपोधनो वनमभिराममृद्धिमत् ।
मनीषया बहुविधरत्नभूषितं
ससर्ज यन्नास्ति शतक्रतोरपि ॥

meaning.en: And that sage, the ascetic who spread the fame of the Bhrigu line, by his mind's power created a beautiful, opulent forest adorned with jewels of many kinds, such as even Indra does not have.
